META ADS

Campaign Analysis & Performance Marketing

Exploring campaign performance, conversion metrics, and data-driven advertising.

01 · Campaign level

Campaign Overview

The campaign view summarises results in one row: amount spent, purchase conversion value and Purchase ROAS. It is the quickest way to judge overall performance before drilling into ad sets and ads.

Learning & analysis: this is a review of campaign data. I am not claiming sole ownership or management of this campaign. Names are redacted; all visible metrics are unchanged.
02 · Ad set level

Ad Set Analysis

Ad sets can be reviewed side by side to compare how each one performs, for example by amount spent, conversion value and Purchase ROAS. Comparing them shows which audiences or setups are worth a closer look.

I have not created or optimised every ad set shown. Ad set names are redacted for confidentiality.
03 · Ad level

Ad Performance

Individual ads can be ranked and compared using the available metrics. This helps spot which ads return more per rupee spent, so decisions rest on data and not guesses.

Ad names and creative thumbnails are redacted. Creatives are shown separately on the creative portfolio page.
04 · Basics

Key Metrics

Four numbers worth understanding first. Values below are only what the campaign-level screenshot shows, with no claims about improvement.

Amount Spent

The total budget the ads used in the selected date range.In screenshot: ₹124,755.00

Purchases / Conversions

How many times people completed the goal action, here a purchase, after seeing or clicking an ad.The purchase count column is not visible in the screenshots.

Conversion Value

The total money value of the purchases the ads are credited with.In screenshot: ₹899,060.33 (purchases conversion value)

Purchase ROAS

Return on ad spend: conversion value divided by amount spent. A ROAS of 2 means ₹2 of purchase value for every ₹1 spent.In screenshot: 7.21
